title: Milestone Score Tax Causes Score Deduction on Pickup
explanation: At frame 761 (t=13.38s), collecting the 6th coin at (3160, 370) with an existing score of 500 caused score to decrease from 500 to 490 instead of incrementing to 600. Traced to PlayerData.gd:L40-L41 where bug_milestone_score_tax subtracts 10 points on subsequent pickups when score >= 500, violating the design contract that collectibles monotonically increment score.
